required_context: Part I Section A WET table footnote (2): Perform WET testing at first discharge
Part II WET testing requirements and additional WET monitoring and reporting conditions referenced in footnote (3)
Permit effective period and evidence of first discharge or prior Ceriodaphnia dubia WET test dates needed to evaluate a 5-year monitoring cycle within FY2025
source_locator: gcc/final_permit.pdf, page 4, section part_i, WET table, Ceriodaphnia dubia row, MEASUREMENT FREQUENCY column
notes: The nominated span specifies monitoring frequency, not a numeric discharge limit; Purpose A turns on enforceable numeric limits while the Ceriodaphnia dubia row value is Report-only.
